purpose: Current Vault and Node interface illustrations and signed-download verification

vault.method: Actual QMP framebuffer captures from the published, unchanged ISO in disposable offline live sessions. The interactive boot line omitted toram; private workspace remained in guest RAM.

node.method: QEMU QMP framebuffer screenshots converted losslessly from PPM to PNG; no source preview or synthetic widget images.
node.installer_scope: Booted exact published ISO with two owned sparse dummy disks; selected128GiB destination and viewed review. Did not run installation.
node.desktop_scope: Normal installed desktop in a disposable qcow2 overlay over the preserved QA installation of base ISO254a0ef32720707c9ddcc2ea39298d0310607cb3da53f6e0b728af3802692b12. Only six runtime/Guide files changed, directly extracted from the approved RC4 ISO and verified before and after copying. This follows the actual RC4 six-file UI overlay derivation and is not a fresh RC4 ISO installation.

verification.method: Actual xterm output from GnuPG and sha256sum against the exact published local artifacts in an isolated public-only keyring.

separate_signer_check.coordinator: Separate Bitcoin Core test process. This diagnostic PSBT was not prepared by the installed Node.

image_processing: Full frames are lossless WebP. Detail previews are exact pixel crops with recorded bounds and a link to their full frame.
